description: This script performs database migration for MongoDB, specifically migrating suffixed journals and snapshot stores of 'things' and 'policies' to non-suffixed collections, including functions for copying documents, renaming collections, unmapping data formats, and handling migration/reversion processes.

methods.name: reduceStep
methods.description: Reducer function for map-reduce operations, returns the list of values.

methods.name: finalizeStep
methods.description: Finalizer for map-reduce, ensures a single value is returned or throws an error if multiple.

methods.name: checkOk
methods.description: Checks the result of a database command, throws an error if the operation was not successful.

methods.name: copyDocuments
methods.description: Copies all documents from a source collection to a target collection using map-reduce.

methods.name: checkEmpty
methods.description: Ensures a collection is empty before migration steps.

methods.name: renameToDelete
methods.description: Renames a collection by prefixing it with 'z_delete_' for later deletion.

methods.name: unmapJournal
methods.description: Converts a journal collection from map-reduce format to event journal format.

methods.name: unmapSnaps
methods.description: Converts a snapshot store collection from map-reduce format to snapshot store format.

methods.name: migrateThingsOrPolicies
methods.description: Migrates journal and snapshot collections for 'things' or 'policies'.

methods.name: dropAllToDelete
methods.description: Drops all collections with the 'z_delete_' prefix.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs full migration sequence: policies, things, and cleanup.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Reverts the migration by restoring original collection names and dropping migrated collections.
